title: GTA Online Brand Wars
headline: GTA Online Brand Wars
subtitle: Get up to GTA$2M in GTA Online and the Sprunk Sweatsuit and eCola Tracksuit with Twitch Drops
content:
Watch select streamers during the Brand Wars Event to earn up to GTA$2,000,000 and the Sprunk Sweatsuit and eCola Tracksuit.

Link your Twitch and Rockstar Games accounts and watch a participating Twitch channel in the Grand Theft Auto V category:

— Watch for 2 hours and claim GTA$250K
— Watch for 4 hours and claim the Sprunk or eCola Outfit
— Watch for 6 hours and claim GTA$250K
— Watch for 10 hours and claim GTA$500K

Visit https://www.rockstargames.com/gta-online/twitch-drops to learn more.
